{{# Lists fieldtype (App\Fieldtypes\Lists, extends Statamic\Fieldtypes\Lists, registered handle "list") — renders a dynamic list of text inputs the user can add/remove. The submitted value is a 0-indexed array under the field handle. `min_items` and `max_items` config (validated server-side by Lists::rules()) gate the add/remove buttons client-side; server-side validation is authoritative. Initial items come from the field value (existing submission, blueprint default) or default to a single empty row. The if/else split avoids an Antlers inline-ternary edge case where an empty-array value emitted nothing. Note: on a validation-failure re-render `value` is the raw resubmitted array (from old()), so the emitted JSON must be escaped — `| to_json` escapes double quotes but NOT single quotes, and the x-data attribute is single-quoted, so an item like `it's` or `x' onmouseover='…` would otherwise break out of the attribute (reflected XSS, UAMS-Web/uams-statamic-archive#881). `| sanitize` HTML-entity-encodes the JSON; the browser decodes the entities back to valid JSON before Alpine parses x-data. The single quoting is load-bearing in a second way (UAMS-Web/uams-statamic-archive#2060), though not for the reason once recorded here (UAMS-Web/uams-statamic-archive#2131). `| sanitize` is `htmlspecialchars(…, ENT_QUOTES)` and DOES encode double quotes, so the value branch below is already immune. The literal `"` comes from the ELSE branch, which never passes through `sanitize`: in a double-quoted attribute that truncates at the JSON's first `"` and the CSP parser reports `Expected "]" but got EOF`. The state itself moved into the registered `listField` component, because an inline object literal with method shorthand is a CSP parse error that left this field rendering no inputs. The composite inputs intentionally omit `x-model` / js_attributes — Alpine's auto-bound `form.{{ handle }}` would clobber the array shape; the standard `name="handle[idx]"` submission carries the data. #}} {{ if value && ( value | length ) > 0 }} {{ initial_items_json = value | to_json | sanitize }} {{ else }} {{ initial_items_json = '[""]' }} {{ /if }}
